answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 86 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh army of identities has no way to grade its own output. The trellis register is checked at draw time, walnut lists the eligible set, and quill seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 86 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an adversary pays for every seat it wants. That is 4 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
